# Microvania Toolkit Tiled Object Templates

This is the generated catalog for the **57** object templates currently shipped under
`tiled/templates/`. The `.tx` tree is the source of truth: adding or removing a template and
rerunning the generator updates both this catalog and `README.html`.

The Microvania set covers compact exploration, progression, environment/FX, interaction,
simple enemies, and the authored boss set.

New creators should start with the [complete creator guide](../../docs/CREATOR_WORKFLOW.html);
use this generated catalog when you need every property and default.

## Setup In Tiled

1. Open `MVTK.tiled-project` at the repository root in Tiled 1.12.x.
2. Place templates from this folder on the map's visible `templates` object layer.
3. Override only the per-instance properties your room needs.
4. Save the TMX, then use **File ▸ Export Current Room**.
5. In Defold, run **Project ▸ Reload Editor Scripts**, **Import Assets**,
   **Create Rooms**, **Validate All**, then **Build**.

## Grouped Custom Properties

Most templates keep identity selectors and required IDs at the top level, then collect
related tuning in one-level collapsible groups. The intentionally tiny `solid_box`,
`solid_slope`, `grapple_box`, `grapple_slope`, `grapple_point`, `one_way_platform`, and `player_start` templates remain flat.

Legacy flat overrides in existing maps remain supported. Newly placed templates already
include the grouped properties; no upgrade step is needed.

## Linked enemy art

Enemy art can be linked with the optional art file property. Select a numbered frame such as enemies/ghost_enemy/idle_01.png outside the Defold project, then Export Current Room. Export copies the skin folder and Prepare & Check syncs it. A deliberate enemy_type keeps its stats and behaviour while the linked skin supplies the art. Blank art keeps today's preset or directly supplied skin workflow.

## Lights, anchors and blocks

Set the room map darkness float to 0–0.9; absent values use game_config.visual.default_room_darkness. Environment ▸ Light Source adds a radius/intensity-controlled light. Interaction ▸ Torch (torch_holder) switches a light with Interact: choose starts_lit, require_interact and allow_extinguish, optional labels, sound IDs and set_flag. Paint visible torch art in Tiled. Empty IDs use the placed object.

Navigation ▸ Grapple Point is a small static grapple target without script overrides. Tune the player hook in Project ▸ Game Settings… ▸ Grapple and mark the target with visible anchor art. See the Grappling guide for surfaces, exact shapes and obstruction rules.

Physics ▸ Pushable Block uses a resizable rectangle and captured Tiled art. Walk into it to push, or hold Interact beside it and move to grab and pull. move_embedded_tiles moves that art with the block; mass is emitted into the collision component and gravity_scale controls movement. Set a pressure plate’s allow_world to true to let the block hold it down.

All four templates belong on the top-level templates object layer and bake into editable gameobjects in the room collection.

## Template Version Marker

Every `.tx` template carries an `mvtk_template_version` custom property. Keep it intact
when copying or instancing a template. The validator compares it with the supported set in
[`mvtk/tiled/template_versions.lua`](../../mvtk/tiled/template_versions.lua).

For every default value and property description, open
[`README.html`](README.html), which is generated from the same live catalog.
